chunks: He said, and it has been reported from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
Three (things) demolish the body, and perhaps may even kill – Eating the Jerk of the forest, and entering the bathroom upon the (full) belly, and marrying the old women.
He said, and Abu Is’haq Al-Nahawandy has increased in it: ‘And copulating with the women upon the filled (belly)’.

key_terms.الْغَابِّ: Of the forest (implying wild or specific origin)

ai.seo_question: What are the three things that demolish the body according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) outlines three specific dietary and lifestyle habits that weaken the body's constitution (*badan*) and may lead to premature death: consuming aged, preserved meat (*al-qadid al-ghabb*), entering the bathhouse while the stomach is full, and marrying elderly women. Abu Ishaq al-Nahawandi adds a fourth factor, noting that sexual intercourse with women while the stomach is full is also detrimental. This narration reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of linking physical health to spiritual and social practices, emphasizing moderation and the physiological effects of timing and age.
